schemaChange: Optional stable hair/face IDs; old body/outfit and format versions retained. Strict whitelist; one player record across all scenes.
codeMerge: Selected classroom-native visual/UI/persistence changes only; no bulk Sources/Vendor overwrite. Current teacher, six students plus P7, rules, teams, save transfer and output privacy retained.

limitations: No device CPU/GPU timing or touch responsiveness measurement was performed.
User-reported TV/disconnect misalignment is addressed in code; real AirPlay/TV/disconnect validation needs user screenshots.

P3-P7 reuse existing approved character resources; distinct character art remains missing. Teacher host has a private joining UI. Independent body variants remain missing; existing rigs support the new shared hair, face and cosmetic outfits.
Offline review demonstrates fixed-canvas geometry; it is not UIKit capture or proof of device repair.

offlineArtReview.GIFScope: Offline actual walk component composites and existing battle sampler; not UIKit capture or device performance proof

missing: Independent body variants; existing body retained.
